what: A text block is painted only on the letters with a 140° tilted gradient (background-clip: text). From when the block’s top edge hits 85% of the screen until its bottom edge hits 50%, the dark-side boundary moves from upper left to lower right with the scroll, turning light letters dark. The soft width of the boundary is 12% of the width the text occupies. Whatever has been painted does not revert when scrolling back up, and blocks already on screen at load start counting from where they are.

options.start: Screen-height share where painting begins (group top edge), default .85
options.end: Share of screen height fully painted (bottom end of the group), default .5
options.angle: Boundary angle (deg, css linear-gradient angle), default 140
options.soft: Soft width = Share of letter width, default .12
options.--fx-light: Lighter-side color (css variable), default var(--kf-bg) — from white text on a color panel to ink-colored text

use:
Paragraph

Paragraph

…
— without group, a single element is treated as one group

from.where: index.html .sh-statement (original text-color-reveal: startRatio .85 · endRatio .5 · angle 140 · softRatio .12, per group [data-reveal-group], progress = max(previous, current), recounted from baseline if on screen when opened, white text → ink text)
